findings.entity: small clear glass bottle on counter behind the two bowls
findings.description: At 4.25s and all earlier frames the white counter space between/behind the steel bowl and the white bowl is empty; at 4.5s, with the camera essentially static (bowls and jar at the same screen positions), a small clear glass bottle is suddenly standing there and persists for the rest of the clip. No hand places it and nothing occluded that spot in the prior frame.

At 6.0-7.0s the range shows roughly one knob between the oven door's left edge and the central display with four knobs to its right; by 7.5-8.5s the same range shows three knobs left of the display and the display sits proportionally farther from the oven-door edge, implying the control panel layout rearranged during the camera drift. Hand occlusion of the left knobs at 6.5-7.0s makes this partly ambiguous.
